tool.name: NCBI Taxonomy SQLite builder
tool.command: #if $taxonomy.taxonomy_source == 'cached': #set $taxonomy_dir = $taxonomy.taxonomy_table.fields.path #else mkdir taxonomy && ln -s '$taxonomy.nodes' taxonomy/nodes.dmp && ln -s '$taxonomy.names' taxonomy/names.dmp && #set $taxonomy_dir = 'taxonomy' #end if python '$__tool_directory__/data_manager_ncbi_taxonomy_sqlite.py' '$taxonomy_dir' '$name' '$description' '$output_file'

validator.message: No NCBI Taxonomy downloads are available
No NCBI Taxonomy database download is available

param.name: name
param.label: Display name of taxonomy database
param.help: Optional label used when generating the description. The table identity is derived from the source files.

param.name: description
param.label: Description of taxonomy database
param.help: Leave blank to generate a description from the display name and source digest.

tool.help:
The data manager creates a SQLite version the NCBI Taxonomy database, using the plain text files of the NCBI database as input. Storing the database as a SQLite database allows for faster querying.
Input is either from the individual files (nodes.dmp and names.dmp) from the NCBI Taxonomy database or from a previously downloaded code of the database stored as "reference data" in the Galaxy server.
.. class: infomark
The table identity is derived from the content of ``nodes.dmp`` and ``names.dmp``. If you leave the display name or description blank, a deterministic description containing the source digest is generated.
